stemMd: At a workshop, each participant chooses exactly one of three sessions. Session Moss has 18 participants and Session Reed has 22. There are 55 participants altogether. Which conclusion follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Moss and Reed have equal attendance.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The third session has more participants than Reed.

options.label: C
options.textMd: At least five participants attended two sessions.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The third session has no participants.

explanationMd: The sessions are exhaustive and mutually exclusive. Subtract 18+22 from 55 to obtain 15 in the remaining session.

distractorRationale.e: The first two counts total only forty.
